text: {"version":1,"kind":"analytics","reading":"The question asks for the win rate against the competitor Splunk broken down by sales region, but this project has no sales region dimension, so I compute the overall win rate against Splunk (won closed opportunities divided by all closed opportunities where Splunk was the recorded competitor) and flag the missing regional breakdown.","measures":[{"ref":"column:SALES.OPPORTUNITY_ENHANCED.OPPORTUNITY_ID","aggregation":"count_distinct","scope":[{"ref":"dimension:opportunity.COMPETITOR_C","op":"eq","values":["Splunk"],"source":"question"},{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_WON","op":"is_true","values":[true],"source":"question"}],"alias":"won_count_vs_splunk"},{"ref":"column:SALES.OPPORTUNITY_ENHANCED.OPPORTUNITY_ID","aggregation":"count_distinct","scope":[{"ref":"dimension:opportunity.COMPETITOR_C","op":"eq","values":["Splunk"],"source":"question"},{"ref":"dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_CLOSED","op":"is_true","values":[true],"source":"question"}],"alias":"closed_count_vs_splunk"},{"derived":{"kind":"ratio","numerator":"measure:0","denominator":"measure:1"},"alias":"win_rate_vs_splunk"}],"groupBy":[],"display":[],"filters":[],"expectedShape":"scalar","unresolved":[{"clause":"by sales region","options":[],"material":true,"question":"This project has no sales region dimension, so I can't break the win rate down by region — should I return the overall win rate against Splunk instead?"}],"provenance":{"column:SALES.OPPORTUNITY_ENHANCED.OPPORTUNITY_ID":"q:win rate","dimension:opportunity.COMPETITOR_C":"q:against Splunk","dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_WON":"q:win rate","dimension:opportunity_enhanced.IS_CLOSED":"q:win rate"}}
